clips.source_prompt: Medium shot of a motorcycle rider navigating a rocky desert wash. 16mm Ektachrome, heavy grain, anamorphic 2.39:1. A 30-year-old Mexican man standing on the foot pegs of a dusty 1965 Triumph TR6SC, letting the bike move underneath him over uneven rocky terrain. Larger stones and rough ground. The bike slows — the engine sputters and coughs. The rider sits down on the seat, puts both boots on the ground as the bike rolls to a stop. Pre-dusk light — amber deepening to bronze. Shadows longer than Scene 1. The warmth is leaving the air. Distant mountains on the horizon.
